title: What comes for a camp in the night (F16, docs/story/camp.md)

settings.description: Where the camp is (CampSite.setting: town or indoors) -> the land a group is for there, over the region's: a town's streets and a roof have their own visitors. The wild goes by the region.

region_settings.description: Region id -> setting (town, indoors) -> the land a group is for there, over `settings`: Castle Ravenloft's halls have the castle's own visitors (bats, the dead, vampire spawn), not any house's rats and shadows.

interrupt_on.description: Region id -> how many faces of the d6 (1 to 5) break a Long Rest taken in a risky place there; a region not listed is 1. Castle Ravenloft's is 2: one night in three.

lands.description: Region id -> the lie of the land a group is for (forest, marsh, mountain, castle).

default_land.description: The land of a region not listed.

levels.description: The party levels (its milestone level) the group comes for, lowest and highest.

text.description: What the one on watch sees as it comes (the fight's title).
